# ObjektHaus

> ObjektHaus is a Bangladeshi design studio making handcrafted plywood objects, each named after a flower and shipped with a numbered botanical archive card. Prices in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT); delivery across Bangladesh.

## Pages
- [Exhibition](https://objekthausstudio.lovable.app/): the main exhibition of objects
- [Botanical Archive](https://objekthausstudio.lovable.app/archive): every object and its flower
- [Order](https://objekthausstudio.lovable.app/order): checkout
- [Contact](https://objekthausstudio.lovable.app/contact): reach the studio
- [Privacy](https://objekthausstudio.lovable.app/privacy)
- [Terms](https://objekthausstudio.lovable.app/terms)
